title: Tips for making a liminal space game?
author: Nightblade1789
selftext:
I'm using Codex, Blender, and Godot all connected together with Codex also making textures and assets with some downloaded from CGTrader. I'm pretty far in with the main area and the first level is done, but I'm wondering some tips people may have that have made one before, such as how you got the filters right or where you get your textures from/created to make it more photorealistic? 

Any tips really, I'm doing a different take on the genre and want it to be good lol any other tools you're using?
